description: Pipeline Stages with Enforced Transitions: Create a pipeline system for multi-step workflow automation with named stages, valid transitions, cases, and hook system.
steps: 1. Create src/nexus/workflows/pipeline.py with: StageKind enum (working, review, done, cancelled). PipelineStage dataclass (id: str, name: str, kind: StageKind, position: int, config: dict). PipelineTransition dataclass (from_stage_id: str, to_stage_id: str, condition: str | None = None). CaseStatus enum (active, completed, cancelled).

2. Create PipelineCase dataclass: id (str), pipeline_id (str), current_stage_id (str), status (CaseStatus), history (list of stage transitions with timestamps), created_at (datetime), updated_at (datetime).

3. Create PipelineEngine class: __init__(stages: list[PipelineStage], transitions: list[PipelineTransition]). Methods: create_case(pipeline_id: str) -> PipelineCase, advance_case(case: PipelineCase, target_stage_id: str) -> PipelineCase (raises InvalidTransitionError if not a valid edge), validate_transition(from_stage_id: str, to_stage_id: str) -> bool, get_available_transitions(stage_id: str) -> list[PipelineTransition].

4. Hook system: PipelineEngine.register_hook(stage_id: str, event: 'on_enter' | 'on_exit', callback: Callable). When advance_case() moves a case, call on_exit hooks for the old stage and on_enter hooks for the new stage. Hooks receive (case, stage) as arguments.
6. Update src/nexus/workflows/__init__.py to export PipelineEngine, PipelineStage, PipelineTransition, PipelineCase, StageKind, InvalidTransitionError.

7. Create tests/test_pipeline.py with tests: create pipeline with stages, create case starts at first stage, advance_case moves through valid transitions, advance_case raises InvalidTransitionError for invalid transitions, get_available_transitions returns valid targets, on_enter and on_exit hooks fire correctly, case history tracks transitions, full pipeline lifecycle (working -> review -> done).
acceptance_criteria: PipelineStage has id, name, kind, position, config
PipelineTransition defines valid edges between stages
PipelineCase tracks current stage and transition history
Hook system fires on_enter and on_exit callbacks on stage changes
Existing workflow tests still pass (python3.12 -m pytest tests/test_workflows.py -q)
